entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Mehmed Pasha Kukavica Mosque is a former mosque, in partial ruins, located in the town of Foča, in the Republika Srpska political division of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Completed in 1752, during the Ottoman era, the mosque was destroyed in 1992, during the Bosnian War.
